headline: Asian Stocks Weaken at Start of Week, Tech Stocks Weigh
summary: Asian stock markets weakened on Monday, led by the Kospi index, which fell 2.34%. Technology stocks were a drag on the market.
why: The Kospi tracks South Korea's largest listed companies, including major semiconductor makers, so its moves reflect the country's tech-heavy market.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The report states the Kospi index fell 2.34% on the day.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report says technology stocks weighed on Asian markets, with the Kospi leading the decline.
